found_while: 2026-11-13: gap batch 4 review (WWII split into theatres)

items.name: European Theatre of World War II
items.why: V-E Day ended the war in Europe, not the whole war: this span lets it 'end' something true. Part_of world-war-2; Stalingrad, D-Day, the Battle of Britain and the invasion of the Soviet Union are part_of it.

items.name: Pacific War
items.why: The existing 'Japan's Surrender Ends the Pacific War' has no Pacific War to end. Part_of world-war-2; Pearl Harbor began it; Midway and Hiroshima are part_of it.
